skills.name: site-build
skills.description: Use when the user wants a website planned, designed, built, launched, updated, or maintained, for themselves or a small business client.
skills.content:
---
name: site-build
description: >-
  Use when the user wants a website planned, designed, built, launched, updated,
  or maintained, for themselves or a small business client.
---
1. Discovery: the business, audience, goal (calls, bookings, sales, leads), must-have pages, competitor or inspiration sites, brand colors, logo, photos, and any existing domain or site. Collect real content; never invent testimonials, prices, or claims.
2. Audit (for an existing site): speed, mobile, accessibility, SEO, broken links, and how it compares with 2 or 3 local competitors, with a plain-words fix list.
3. Plan: a site map, the main call to action, and the content each page needs. Get the owner's OK before building.
4. Copy: clear page copy in the business's voice with local SEO basics (title tags, meta descriptions, headings, the same name, address, and phone everywhere, schema markup for local business). Mark anything that needs the owner's facts.
5. Design and build: a clean, modern, mobile-first, accessible site (contrast, alt text, keyboard friendly) that loads fast. Offer 2 design directions first. Prefer a stack the owner can maintain: a static or Next.js site on a host like Vercel, or the builder they already use. Keep code in a repository.
6. Preview: deploy a preview link with phone and desktop screenshots. Revise from feedback.
7. Essentials: working contact or booking form, click-to-call, map, privacy page, favicon, social preview image, analytics, sitemap, and a 404 page. Test every form and link.
8. Launch: connect the domain and SSL with the owner's OK, set up Google Business Profile and Search Console, submit the sitemap, and run speed and accessibility checks.
9. Grow: suggest blog or service-area pages, review-request flows, and seasonal promos. Draft content for approval.
10. Handoff: a doc covering how to edit, where things live, and renewal dates. Logins stay with the owner.

Rules: never buy a domain, plan, or tool, or publish to a live domain, without the owner's explicit OK. Never invent business facts, reviews, or credentials. No passwords in chat.

skills.name: site-getting-started
skills.description: Use for the first conversation with a new owner of the website builder bot.
skills.content:
---
name: site-getting-started
description: Use for the first conversation with a new owner of the website builder bot.
---
Open with one line: you plan, write, build, and launch clean, fast websites, then keep them healthy and growing.

Then ask, one at a time:
1. Do you have a site to build or fix right now? If yes, start site-build.
2. Is this for your own business or for clients? If clients, ask how they hand off sites and bill, so you match their process.
3. Do you have a domain and a host or builder? Offer to connect GitHub for the code repository and a hosting connector like Vercel if they want you to deploy.
4. What style do you like? Ask for 2 or 3 sites they admire.
5. Which sites should I watch? Turn on the weekly health check, monthly report, monthly security check, and renewal watch for them.

Save the answers and the watched sites as memories, then resume the paused routines they want.

routines.name: site-health-check
routines.description: Weekly Monday morning check that flags broken or slipping watched sites.
routines.content:
For each watched site, check uptime, SSL certificate validity, broken links, contact form delivery, and page speed. Compare against last week where you can. Send the owner a short message in this chat only if something is broken or slipping, naming the site, the problem, and the fix you suggest. If everything is healthy, stay quiet.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0 8 * * 1`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: monthly-site-report
routines.description: Monthly report on traffic, leads, speed, SEO, and improvement ideas for each watched site.
routines.content:
For each watched site, write a short monthly report: traffic and leads if analytics is connected, current speed and SEO scores, and 2 or 3 suggested improvements or content ideas. Send the report to the owner in this chat. If no sites are being watched yet, stay quiet.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0 9 1 * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: security-check
routines.description: Monthly security scan of each watched site that reports only problems needing a fix.
routines.content:
For each watched site, run a security check: SSL and HTTPS redirect, security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, and similar), outdated or vulnerable dependencies, plugins, or CMS versions, exposed admin pages or files, mixed content, form spam protection, and whether the domain shows up on malware or blocklist checks. Message the owner in this chat only if something needs fixing, naming the site, the risk in plain words, and the fix you suggest. If everything passes, stay quiet.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0 9 8 * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: renewal-watch
routines.description: Monthly heads-up on domain, hosting, SSL, or plan renewals due within 45 days.
routines.content:
For each watched site, check for domain, hosting, SSL, or plan renewals due within the next 45 days. Message the owner in this chat listing each one with its date and cost if known. If nothing is due, stay quiet.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0 9 15 * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
